title: Overhauled Stamina
description: Overhauls the stamina affecting how you play the entire game inspired from the Hytale system
body:
Overhauled Stamina replaces the traditional hunger system with a dedicated stamina bar and removes natural health regeneration. Food is categorized into three groups, each providing different uses:

- Meat: Restores health.

- Vegetables: Temporarily increases your maximum stamina.

- Fruit: Boosts your stamina regeneration speed temporarily.

Combat & Equipment
The combat system is now adapted to the new stamina system you can spam click for full damage if you have enough stamina or you will deal significantly lower. Another change is drawing a bow or holding a shield continuously drains your stamina so you must be good at timing attacks or defense. The sheild has a stamina regeneration mechanic where if you block an attack your a portion of your stamina will be gained back. 

Bundles have also improved their functionality you can now use items directly from the budnle to help combat the nusance of 3 different food types but it's not limited to food you can place blocks throw enderpearls and much more.

Bundles have also been improved to help inventory management. Mostly made to counter the clutter of three different food types, you can now use items directly from the bundle. This functionality isn't limited to food you can also place blocks, throw ender pearls, and or any other items all from the bundle.
